scope: Selected primary brain arms only; independent read-only review of saved source papers and deposited metadata. No download, model fit or output regeneration performed.
evidence_rules: Paper-wide protocols are identified separately from selected-sample deposited fields.
Reported atmospheric concentrations are not converted into instilled body-weight doses or vice versa.
Arithmetic age/duration implications are labeled and are not substituted for reported collection ages.
PDF page numbers are one-based local PDF pages; printed article pages are identified where different.

studies.citation: Rajagopalan et al., J Clin Invest (2020), Metabolic effects of air pollution exposure and reversibility.
studies.selected_brain_arm: Chow-fed hypothalamus: filtered-air GSM4337097–GSM4337100 (n=4) versus PM GSM4337101–GSM4337103 (n=3). The four hypothalamus HFD samples and other tissues/cessation arms are excluded.
studies.strain_model_sex: Male C57BL/6J mice on chow; conventional mice, not a humanized APOE or alpha-synuclein model.
studies.pollutant_dose_or_concentration: Concentrated ambient PM2.5, approximately 60–120 µg/m³ during exposure; the paper reports mean 80 µg/m³ (approximately ten times ambient). Comparator: filtered air.
studies.route: Inhalational delivery with a versatile aerosol concentrator and enrichment system. Whole-body versus nose-only chamber configuration is not specified in the reviewed main paper or selected GEO sample fields.
studies.age_at_start: Three weeks old (paper study-wide exposure design).
studies.age_at_collection: No per-sample collection age or final-exposure-to-harvest lag is given in the selected GEO fields. Approximately 17 weeks would follow arithmetically from 3 weeks plus 14 weeks; this is not a separately reported collection age.

evidence_scope.sample_specific: GEO sample titles and treatment/tissue fields identify the selected chow FA/PM hypothalamus samples.
evidence_scope.study_wide: Paper p1 and GEO Series_summary supply male C57BL/6J model and the 14-week exposure description; paper p2 states subsequent transcriptome analyses were restricted to males. The exact daily schedule and start age come from paper p1.

unknowns_or_cautions: The source concentration is an atmospheric exposure concentration, not an administered mg/kg dose.
The main paper refers further methods to supplemental material; that supplemental methods file is not in the saved library reviewed here.
Do not assign the cessation-arm additional eight weeks to these primary hypothalamus samples.

studies.citation: Zhang et al., Science (2025), Lewy body dementia promotion by air pollutants.
studies.selected_brain_arm: Anterior cingulate cortex: intranasal PBS GSM8990943–GSM8990946 (n=4) versus PM nasal GSM8990951–GSM8990954 (n=4). PFF, PM-PFF and combined PM-PFF/PM arms are excluded.
studies.strain_model_sex: Humanized WT alpha-synuclein (hWT alphaSyn) mice: FVB;129S6-Sncatm1Nbm Tg(SNCA)1Nbm/J, JAX strain 010710. Sex is not stated for the RNA-seq animals in the reviewed main PDF or deposited selected-sample characteristics.
studies.pollutant_dose_or_concentration: Intranasal 2 µL PM2.5 suspension at 5 mg/mL in PBS per administration, as reported. Comparator: intranasal PBS. No conversion to an inhaled concentration or body-weight dose is made here.
studies.route: Intranasal administration into the nostrils using a pipette, with the mouse held supine.
studies.schedule_duration: Once every two days for 2 months for the selected RNA-seq PM arm; PBS is the corresponding intranasal control arm.
studies.age_at_start: Two months old (paper Mouse RNA-seq section and GEO Series_overall_design / selected Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1).
studies.age_at_collection: The arm lasts 2 months after initiation at age 2 months; approximately 4 months is implied, but an individual collection age and interval from last nasal dose to collection are not explicitly reported.

evidence_scope.sample_specific: GEO samples identify ACC and humanized aSyn WT genotype; their treatment protocols specify the 2-month-old model and 2-month arm. Library names distinguish Control5–Control8 from PMA2775/PMA2776/PMA2778/PMA2779.
evidence_scope.study_wide: Paper Intranasal treatment with PM2.5 supplies dose and every-two-day schedule. Main Fig5 / RNA-seq text establish nasal PM for 2 months. The default PM2.5-1 material is described in the general sampling methods as the Baoji, China sample; this is not reannotated per individual GSM.

unknowns_or_cautions: Sex is unknown in the inspected sources; do not infer male from another mouse experiment in the paper.
The paper also contains a 10-month C57BL/6 wildtype brain-atrophy experiment; that is a different arm and does not describe these RNA-seq samples.
Do not substitute the PFF stereotaxic injection route/dose or the combined-arm 7-week schedule for this PM-only comparison.
The paper discusses an inhalation-equivalent atmospheric concentration; the actual RNA-seq intervention is nasal instillation and that equivalence is not treated as a measured chamber concentration.
The reported 2 µL is not relabeled as 2 µL per nostril.

studies.citation: Ku et al., Particle and Fibre Toxicology (2017), NF-kappaB-regulated microRNA-574-5p underlies synaptic and cognitive impairment in response to atmospheric PM2.5 aspiration.
studies.selected_brain_arm: Nine hippocampal miRNA arrays: saline GSM2465786–GSM2465788, PM2.5 1 mg/kg GSM2465789–GSM2465791, and PM2.5 5 mg/kg GSM2465792–GSM2465794; three arrays per group. No black-carbon or lentiviral-interference arm is selected.
studies.strain_model_sex: Male C57BL/6 mice; approximately 8 weeks old at the start of the animal treatment protocol. No substrain suffix is supplied in the reviewed paper.
studies.pollutant_dose_or_concentration: PM2.5 at 1 or 5 mg/kg body weight per administration; paper also reports 20 or 100 µg in 20 µL saline, respectively. Comparator: saline.
studies.route: Oropharyngeal aspiration, with isoflurane anesthesia before PM2.5 or saline administration.
studies.age_at_start: Approximately 8 weeks (paper Animal treatment section); GEO records male sex and treatment but not individual age.
studies.age_at_collection: Animals were sacrificed 18 h after the final exposure. Absolute collection age is not explicitly tabulated; approximately 12 weeks follows from the reported starting age and duration.

evidence_scope.sample_specific: GEO selected GSM characteristics identify male hippocampal samples and saline/1/5 mg/kg groups; the repeated sample treatment protocol confirms oropharyngeal aspiration every other day for 4 weeks.
evidence_scope.study_wide: Paper Methods > Animal treatment supplies C57BL/6 strain, approximate starting age, administration volumes, anesthesia and the 18-hour final-exposure-to-harvest interval. The tissue collection description specifies no interference treatment for these samples.

unknowns_or_cautions: This is aspiration of a suspension, not a measured whole-body airborne PM concentration.
The paper includes separate black-carbon and lentiviral mechanistic experiments; their doses or six-week pretreatment intervals do not apply to these nine primary arrays.
The paper discusses ambient-concentration calculations to motivate doses; those are not measured chamber exposures for this arm.
No individual collection age or C57BL/6 substrain suffix is available in the reviewed sources.

studies.citation: Nakamya et al., International Journal of Molecular Sciences (2025), Age- and ApoE Genotype-Dependent Transcriptomic Responses to O3 in the Hippocampus of Mice.
studies.selected_brain_arm: All 24 sequenced hippocampal samples: age-at-start 3 or 17 months × human APOE3 or APOE4 targeted replacement × filtered air or ozone, n=3 per eight combinations.
studies.strain_model_sex: Male human APOE3 and APOE4 gene-targeted replacement mice obtained from Taconic. A specific C57BL/6 background is not established in the reviewed paper/IDF. SDRF strain strings are Mus musculus musculus x M. m. domesticus for 23 animals and Mus musculus domesticus for Sample 1.
studies.brain_region: Hippocampus isolated from the left hemisphere; right hemisphere fixed for other assays.
studies.pollutant_dose_or_concentration: O3 at 0.8 ppm during exposure sessions. Comparator: filtered air.
studies.route: Gaseous ozone exposure at the UAB environmental exposure facility. The reviewed paper/IDF do not name the chamber configuration (whole-body versus nose-only), so no such configuration is assigned.
studies.schedule_duration: Eight cycles; each cycle has 5 days of O3 or filtered air for 7 h/day, followed by 9 days of filtered air. Eight 14-day cycles imply 112 days (16 weeks), a calendar calculation rather than a separately reported harvest date.
studies.age_at_start: Three or seventeen months (paper §4.1 and IDF growth protocol); these are exposure-onset labels, not terminal tissue ages.
studies.age_at_collection: Paper §4.2 states tissue collection after completion of exposure. Exact terminal age and last-O3-session-to-harvest lag are not reported; do not relabel the samples as 3 or 17 months at death.

evidence_scope.sample_specific: SDRF identifies each animal/run, genotype, hippocampus, environmental stress and the 3/17-month labels. There are two SDRF rows per animal for paired read files; deduplication by Source Name gives 24 animals.
evidence_scope.study_wide: Paper §4.1 and IDF growth/treatment protocols establish male sex, targeted replacement model, starting ages and cyclic concentration/schedule. The paper describes 14–16 animals per experimental group overall, whereas the deposited sequenced subset has three per stratum; these are different denominators.

unknowns_or_cautions: Specific strain background, chamber geometry and exact final-dose-to-harvest interval are not established by the saved sources.
SDRF Sample 1 / ERR14708304 (3-month-start ApoE3 filtered air) has the differing strain string; this is one animal, not complete strain-by-genotype confounding.
The model is humanized at APOE. Gene-level quantification against the mouse reference does not validate human APOE allele-specific expression.
Keep the paper-wide 14–16 animals per group separate from n=3 sequenced biological replicates per stratum.
